Between:
Palleti Saidulu  ...Petitioner/accused  AND The State of Telangana,
Rep. by its Public Prosecutor,
High Court of Telangana, Hyderabad and another  ...Respondents  ORDER This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner/accused seeking to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.4655 of 2025 on the file of II Additional Judicial Magistrate-cum-Additional Junior Civil Judge at L.B Nagar, Ranga Reddy District, for the offences under Section 420 and 406 Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 76, 4 of the Chit Fund Act.

2. Heard Mr. Rapolu Bhaskar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1.
3.

When this Court is not inclined to entertain the criminal petition on the ground that specific allegations are levelled against the petitioner and that the grounds raised in the criminal petition require adjudication by the trial Court, at this juncture, learned counsel for the petitioner requested this Court to dispense with the presence of the petitioner/accused in C.C.No.4655 of 2025 on the file of II Additional Judicial Magistrate-cum-Additional Junior Civil Judge at L.B Nagar, Ranga Reddy District.

entities.text: II Additional Judicial Magistrate-cum-Additional Junior Civil Judge at L.B Nagar, Ranga Reddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has not opposed the submissions made by the learned counsel for petitioner.

5. In view of the above submissions, the presence of the petitioner/accused in C.C.No.4655 of 2025 on the file of II Additional Judicial Magistrate-cum-Additional Junior Civil Judge at L.B Nagar,
Ranga Reddy District, is dispensed with, subject to the condition that he shall be represented through his counsel on each and every date of hearing.
